newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES FIRMER AGAINST HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES FIRMER AGAINST HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on most hard currencies at the end of a fairly quiet interbank session on Tuesday, dealers said.
"There wasn't much trade today, in fact it looks like there won't be much happening this week," one dealer said.
"But we had more inflows than payments and our dollar went up a bit," he added.
At Tuesday's close, the local unit was trading at 10.2200/2600 against the U.S. dollar, a notch up from Monday's 10.2300/2700, while it edged up against sterling to 15.8980/9690 from 15.9680/16.0310.
It finished the day at 6.7850/8180 against the German mark, up from 6.8610/890, but was quoted largely stable at 2.2740/2850 against South Africa's rand.
